main.description: Ephemeral scoped JWT issued by `e7m agent-token` for agent-led deploy steps. Per ADR-2605232000. The token itself is a JWS (Ed25519); this record captures the audit-meta projection of issued tokens (token CID is hash-of-JWS-payload). Lives in the issuer's PDS, NOT the agent's — issuer-DID is the principal of record.

issuerDid.description: DID of the human or system that issued the token (typically a Steward)

agentDid.description: DID of the agent the token is bound to (e.g., did:web:claude-agent.etzhayyim.com)

capabilityUri.description: AT URI of the parent com.etzhayyim.consent.capability authorizing this token issuance

scopes.description: Action NSIDs the token permits. e.g., ['deploy.cfWorker:karute-did-web', 'deploy.k8s:lg-karute', 'deploy.pages:karute']

jwsHash.description: SHA-256 hex of the issued JWS string (the token value never persists; only its hash for audit correlation)

auditEventUri.description: AT URI of the com.etzhayyim.audit.event record for this issuance (eventType='deploy.token.issued')
